svg.text: What broke, and how long it stayed broken
Every incident on the systems behind this profile. A board shows the present, which is easy to make green. This is the part that cannot be flattered.
RECORDED
OPEN
MEAN TIME TO FIX
WORST
8d
The freshness alarm could not see the largest generated file
same day
cv-siddharth/src/data/store.ts · 2026-08-28 to 2026-08-28 · high
The scanner matched one stamp shape. store.ts emits a TypeScript const instead of the JSON-ish key, so 5,150 lines sat
21 days old and completely outside the alarm's view, with the suite green.
FIX: Match both shapes, then pin store.ts in MUST_BE_STAMPED so it cannot fall out again.
chessDeep.ts reached 29 days stale under a 45-day alarm
same day
cv-siddharth/src/data/chessDeep.ts · 2026-08-28 to 2026-08-28 · medium
Not a dead generator. The daily job never reached it, because an earlier step exited non-zero. One blanket threshold
tuned for the slowest source gave every other file weeks of legal silence.
FIX: Per-file SLAs. Live daily sources get 21 days; the rate-limited Play sweep keeps 45.
The profile understated its own open source by 15 PRs
same day
darkpandawarrior/README.md · 2026-08-28 to 2026-08-28 · high
The generator queried the private product repo while the sentence it maintains is about the public upstream. The
request 422'd, the catch swallowed it, and the README sat at 9 merged PRs against a real 24.
FIX: Read the public upstream, the same repo the portfolio reads. A fetch failure is still swallowed; a dead pattern
now exits 1.
The homepage told every machine reader the platform served zero users
same day
cv-siddharth/ · 2026-08-28 to 2026-08-28 · critical
The metric tile rendered a zero placeholder as its initial text and only reached the real figure through a count-up.
Anything reading HTML without running it, an LLM screener, an ATS parser, a crawler, read 0k+ monthly active users.
FIX: Ship the real value in the markup and zero the node at effect time instead. Guarded by a renderToStaticMarkup
test.
kmp-toolkit's module count was stale by three, and self-contradictory
same day
kmp-toolkit/README.md · 2026-08-28 to 2026-08-28 · medium
36 was right when there were 17 core modules. Three more landed and nothing re-measured. The same README already said
39 further down. No claim covered the number, so a passing audit never looked.
FIX: Corrected on 8 surfaces and covered by a kmp-toolkit-modules claim, measured the same way as its siblings.
Two datasets aged out while a daily job reported success
same day
cv-siddharth/src/data · 2026-08-24 to 2026-08-24 · medium
Every generator keeps the previous file on a fetch error, which is right, and means a broken source looks identical to
a quiet one. chessDeep.ts was 25 days old and weeb.ts 19, with the job green throughout.
FIX: freshness.test.ts: assert an age on anything that stamps itself, and pin the files that must carry a stamp.
Daily refresh red for 8 days, one dead regex
8d open
cv-siddharth/Refresh project media · 2026-08-20 to 2026-08-28 · high
A dash sweep turned 'HireSignal - active' into 'HireSignal: active' and the generator's regex hard-coded the
punctuation. It exited 1 every day, and because the commit step was gated on success, 26 healthy generators were
discarded with it.
FIX: Match the number beside the phrase, never the punctuation between the words. Commit step now runs on always().
Generated 2026-08-28 from data/incidents.json. Dates trace to workflow runs, generatedAt stamps and git history.
